description: CONNECTIONS: the depth-1 neighbourhood of an article — what it REFERS TO and what legislation INVOKES it (cross-references), what AMENDED it, and which court DECISIONS interpret it. Each decision is tagged with the version of the article the court cited (a still-good-law signal) and says how it was resolved. Use to map how a provision connects before drafting, or to find leading cases on it. For the decisions of a PERIOD ("court decisions of the last 12 months on art. 169 and how each was resolved") pass date_from / date_to: they come newest first, with how many fall in the window out of how many interpret the article in all. Pair with lookup_decision (a listed decision → full text) and lookup_article (a listed reference → its text).

date_from.description: Optional: only decisions taken on or after this date — a day (2025-10-26), a month (2025-10) or a year (2025).

date_to.description: Optional: only decisions taken on or before this date — a day, a month or a year, as date_from.

law.description: The act, however it is at hand: a citation ('Legea 265/2022', 'HG 1/2016', 'Ordinul 2594/C/2008'), a common name ('Codul fiscal'), a title any tool printed, or 'normele de aplicare a Legii X'.

order.description: Optional: 'relevance' (the default without a window) or 'date', newest first (the default with a window).

name: get_related
